tools.name: list_components
tools.description: All components the @mojawork/ui barrel exports: selector, area, and the first sentence of what each one does and does not. Non-component exports (types, services, directives) carry their Compodoc API reference instead of a docs.mdx.

tools.name: get_component_doc
tools.description: The docs.mdx of one ui component, verbatim — the truth layer: what it does and does not. Accepts the selector (ui-card), the class name (UiCardComponent) or the folder name (card).

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The usage guide: recommendations — use for, not for, instead, shown in — written by an agent from named sources. The component page (get_component_doc) is the truth; this is the offer. Without "component" the whole guide: "entries" is ONE list holding TWO kinds of entry, told apart by the "kind" fie

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: The usage contract of @mojawork/ui: the rules that hold for EVERY component, not for one — Angular signals and zoneless change detection, the one fixed forms format, styling on the design tokens, the cascade layers a consumer with Tailwind has to get right, the keyboard rules around disabled control
